_comment: Motes hang in the Age's air that no air should hold (Jonah, 2026-10-12): `density` is how many and `size`
how big. Each Age draws its own from its seed: whether they rise or hang perfectly still, and whether they
are pale specks, a faint glow, dark specks or a colour from the wandering sky's palette.
Strange throughout: seen only. Any step brings the whole thing, sparse and small; the dials thicken it.
